mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE > 6.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during three-month RSAFS declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for four consecutive months signals supply-side contraction, which raises input costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during four-month INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and CPI inflation above 2% for two consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance with sticky inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of simultaneous FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL > 2% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the Housing Starts index (HOUST) for six consecutive months signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during six-month HOUST declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) for six consecutive months signals labor market strength, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during six-month PAYEMS increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) for two consecutive quarters signals broad-based demand weakness, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during two-quarter GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05).
